historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and denied the demolition permit for the building at 1529 Sutter Street.
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and denied the demolition permit for the building at 1531 Sutter Street.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works and allowed the demolition permit for the building at 1529 Sutter Street to stand, reversing its previous vote in compliance with a Peremptory Writ of Mandamus.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works and allowed the demolition permit for the building at 1531 Sutter Street to stand, reversing its previous vote in compliance with a Peremptory Writ of Mandamus.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works and allowed the permit to erect a structure at 1531 Sutter Street to stand.
Kimochi Home Project was at 1531 Sutter Street.
The Kimochi Home, a Japanese American senior residence, was located here.
